data.title: Critical PayPal API Outage Resolution
data.mission_parameters: {"business_impact_assessment":[{"immediate_action":"Restore service immediately","impact_area":"Revenue Distribution","severity":"CRITICAL"},{"impact_area":"Customer Payments","severity":"HIGH","immediate_action":"Notify stakeholders of delay"},{"severity":"HIGH","impact_area":"System Reliability","immediate_action":"Implement monitoring"},{"immediate_action":"Address root causes","severity":"MEDIUM","impact_area":"Technical Debt"}],"root_cause_analysis":{"server_service_disruption":{"evidence":"Complete cessation of API calls after November 22","most_likely_cause":"Your PayPal Payouts server or service has stopped running","impact":"No payouts are being processed, revenue distribution is halted"},"manual_intervention":{"evidence":"No new calls after our troubleshooting discussions","risk":"System may not have been restarted after fixes","possible_cause":"System was manually paused/stopped during troubleshooting"},"automated_system_failure":{"secondary_cause":"The automated payout system has encountered a critical failure","evidence":"Multiple 403 errors preceded the stoppage","pattern":"System likely entered a failure state and stopped retrying"}},"next_steps":["Execute server status check immediately","Restore service using recovery procedures","Implement monitoring to prevent recurrence","Conduct post-mortem analysis"],"escalation_path":["Immediate (Now): Verify server status and restart if necessary","1 Hour: If service doesn't restart, escalate to infrastructure team","2 Hours: If still unresolved, activate manual payout procedures","4 Hours: Executive notification of service disruption"],"immediate_action_plan":{"step_4_test_manual_api_call":"curl -v -X POST https://api.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token -u \"YOUR_CLIENT_ID:YOUR_SECRET\" -d \"grant_type=client_credentials\"","step_3_verify_scheduled_tasks":"crontab -l; systemctl list-timers --all; systemctl status paypal-payouts-timer (Look for payout scheduler status)","step_1_verify_server_status":"curl -I https://your-domain.com/health; ssh your-server systemctl status paypal-payouts docker ps | grep paypal","step_2_check_application_logs":"tail -n 100 /var/log/paypal-payouts/app.log (Look for: Application crashes, Memory errors, Configuration issues, Manual shutdown messages)"},"recovery_procedures":{"scenario_4_manual_intervention":"grep -r \"disabled\\|paused\" /etc/paypal-payouts/; Edit configuration file and set enabled=true; systemctl reload paypal-payouts","scenario_2_application_crashed":"journalctl -u paypal-payouts -n 50; systemctl restart paypal-payouts; tail -f /var/log/paypal-payouts/app.log","scenario_1_server_is_down":"systemctl start paypal-payouts; docker start paypal-payouts-container; curl https://your-domain.com/health","scenario_3_scheduler_stopped":"systemctl restart cron; systemctl enable paypal-payouts-timer; systemctl start paypal-payouts-timer"},"problem_identification":"Your PayPal API logs show zero activity since November 22, 2025 - this is a critical issue that requires immediate attention. The last recorded call was at 04:29 with debug ID 8730ed5341f26.","prevention_measures":{"add_auto_restart_policy":"In docker-compose.yml: deploy: restart_policy: condition: on-failure delay: 5s max_attempts: 3 window: 120s","create_dead_man_switch":"Add to crontab: */5 * * * * /usr/local/bin/check-paypal-service.sh (check-paypal-service.sh: #!/bin/bash if ! curl -f https://your-domain.com/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl restart paypal-payouts echo \"PayPal service restarted at $(date)\" | mail -s \"PayPal Service Alert\" admin@yourdomain.com fi)","implement_service_monitoring":"Add to docker-compose.yml: healthcheck: test: ['CMD', 'curl', '-f', 'http://localhost:3000/health'] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 3 start_period: 40s"}}
